newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria 3-mth T-bills 10 pct sold,yielding 80 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria 3-mth T-bills 10 pct sold,yielding 80 pct.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry offer of 5.0 billion levs of three-month floater coupon T-bills was 10.07 percent sold, yielding 80.37 percent, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said.
The paper bears a coupon equal to the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity. The CIR is now set at 25 percent monthly or 300 percent annually.
The issue was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry.
Seven financial institutions took part in Monday's auction, the BNB said.
